author: tomi0x
content: in https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/blob/v5.0.0-alpha.2/apis/beacon/pool/payload_attestations.yaml, `getPoolPayloadAttestations` defines JSON response as an unbounded array but the SSZ response is bounded by `MAX_PAYLOAD_ATTESTATIONS`  so the `SSZ` side might have to silently truncate what `JSON` would otherwise return in full

author: tomi0x
content: I think it makes sense to remove the the `octet-stream` response entirely and keep it similar in spirit to `getPoolAttestationsV2`

author: nflaig
content: yeah `MAX_PAYLOAD_ATTESTATIONS = 4` is only correct if you specifically query for `slot` + `beacon_block_root`, the limit here is kinda irrelevant, we could make it a `ProgressiveList`, I wouldn't use it for all, but since this is a response I don't see what the limit buys us, so what about changing that to `ProgressiveList[PayloadAttestation]`?

author: nflaig
content: we should do the opposite imo, we can add ssz response to `getPoolAttestationsV2`, it's backward compatible to add that to the spec and lodestar already support ssz response there

author: tomi0x
content: actually, `ProgressiveList` sounds right. which also fixes the inconsistency from the other side

author: nflaig
content: I think if you ssz query this api on lodestar right now and pool at attestation from different branches it just blows up 😅  so nice find on this
